This long, wickedly-sharp sword is crafted from the finest
steel possible. It is named the Magebane for its edge, which
is covered in many small serrated points. The combination of
the sharpness and these tiny barbs cause painful, jagged
wounds in the target, disrupting concentration (and thus
spellcasting).

canonicalTextMentions.text:
This thick, weathered bark scroll is inscribed with many
passages written in a bold, flowing hand. Upon scanning its
contents, you discover that it contains the secret methods
of learning and casting the Regeneration spell! This
powerful but short-lived spell rapidly heals the target's
wounds.
